reader.requirement: At --std 85 a procedure-name of a declarative (USE) section, section-name or paragraph-name, may be referenced from a different declarative section or from the nondeclarative portion only by PERFORM: every other referencing statement there (GO TO, GO TO DEPENDING ON, ALTER in either operand position, SORT/MERGE INPUT or OUTPUT PROCEDURE) must be refused, while any reference within the same declarative section, and PERFORM from anywhere, is accepted.
reader.edition-search: Read ResolveProcedureOperand and CheckDeclarativesBoundary: no EditionContext / Year / ConstructRegistry test on the boundary (the method's own doc: 'Every edition'); grep of ProcedureReferenceKind shows only PERFORM (ControlFlowBinder) and RESUME (EcBinder, a 2002+ verb) pass a non-default kind. The only 85-specific neighbour is the §1985:XV.3.2.3 SR3 debugging-section arm in the same method, a different rule.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness pb362 covers the GO TO into a declarative and the PERFORM exemption; not exercised there: GO TO DEPENDING ON, ALTER (both operands), SORT INPUT PROCEDURE naming a declarative section, a section-name target, and the cross-declarative-section reference.

probes.printed: --std 85: COBOL2376 for GO TO DA-1 and GO TO DA from section DB; GO TO DA-1 from MAIN; GO TO M3 DA-1 DEPENDING ON N; ALTER DA-2 TO PROCEED TO DA-1 (procedure-name-1); ALTER X1 TO PROCEED TO DA-1 (procedure-name-2); SORT ... INPUT PROCEDURE IS DA. --std 2023: the same seven, plus the 2023 removals of ALTER and GO TO-alone
probes.expected: §1985:IX.4.8.4 GR3: reference only with a PERFORM statement

probes.printed: compiles and runs: PERFORM DA-3, PERFORM DA, PERFORM DA-2 THRU DA-3 from MAIN; PERFORM DA-3 and PERFORM DA-2 THRU DA-3 from section DB; GO TO DA-3 inside DA; output DA-3 / DA-1 / DA-3 / DA-2 SKIPPED / DA-3 / DA-1 35 / DA-3 / DB-1 35 / DA-3 / DA-2 SKIPPED / DA-3 / END
probes.expected: PERFORM from anywhere and any reference inside the same section are legal

citations.check: OK  §1985:IX.4.8.4 GR3  (4.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR3 ["may be referenced in a different declarative section or in a nondeclarative procedure only with a PERFORM statement"]

reader.notes: One funnel (ResolveProcedureOperand) carries every statement's procedure-name reference into CheckDeclarativesBoundary, which compares section identity and exempts PERFORM only; all seven non-PERFORM forms probed are refused at 85. The diagnostic text cites §2023:14.9.49.3 SR4 rather than the 1985 GR it enforces at --std 85, which is cosmetic, not a conformance failure.

refuter.evidence: Probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-010/us3.cob at --std 85, forms the reader did not try: SORT ... OUTPUT PROCEDURE IS DA (declarative section) -> COBOL2376; MERGE ...
